role: Risk Management Automation & AI Intern (4-Month Internship)
jd:
Our Story & Purpose:
We’re Vancity, a member-owned credit union built on the principles of inclusion and social justice. Since 1946, our relentless commitment to these values has helped us challenge the status quo and break down barriers. We’ve made bold commitments to become net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans, and we’re actively pursuing strategies in Indigenous banking and financial resilience for our members.
As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada, we’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the country’s Top Employers. If you’re ready to join our team of 2,300 diverse individuals, access competitive rewards and benefits, and be part of a greater movement - apply today!
 
Your Role in Supporting Our Members:
As a Risk Management Automation & AI Intern, you will support our Financial Crime, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Fraud, and Security teams by identifying opportunities to improve processes and reduce manual effort through emerging technologies. Working alongside risk professionals and business stakeholders, you will analyze how work is currently performed and explore practical applications of AI, robotic process automation (RPA), intelligent agents, and workflow automation tools. You will contribute to proof-of-concept solutions and recommendations that enhance operational effectiveness while supporting regulatory and risk management standards. This role offers an opportunity to apply technology, data analysis, and innovative thinking to real-world risk management challenges within a regulated financial services environment.
This is a Full-time, 4-Month Internship starting in January 2027. Based at Vancity’s Head Office in Vancouver, you will report to the Chief Risk Officer. While this position provides a hybrid work arrangement, you will be expected to be on-site for events and business demands.
 
How You'll Make an Impact:

- Analyzing existing workflows across Financial Crime, AML, Fraud, and Security operations to understand current processes, operational requirements, and areas of manual effort
- Reviewing investigation and case management activities, including the handling of Unusual Transaction Reports (UTRs) and related risk information
- Identifying opportunities to apply AI, intelligent agents, RPA, and workflow automation to improve efficiency and streamline repetitive processes
- Partnering with business stakeholders to map processes, gather requirements, and document improvement opportunities
- Researching emerging technologies and automation tools relevant to financial crime prevention, fraud monitoring, and risk management activities
- Developing proof-of-concept solutions, prototypes, or recommendations that demonstrate potential efficiency and process improvements
- Analyzing data and process measures to help quantify operational improvements and support business cases
- Supporting testing, change management, and implementation activities associated with new processes and automated solutions
- Presenting findings, recommendations, and business cases to leaders and subject matter experts
- Contributing to initiatives that reduce manual effort and create additional capacity for higher-value risk management activities
 
What You’ll Bring to the Team:

- Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Engineering, Commerce, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate information and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement
- Strong interest in applying technology, AI, automation, and data analysis to real-world business challenges
- Ability to learn and understand complex business processes quickly and translate findings into practical recommendations
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to different stakeholders
- Comfort working with data and using information to support analysis and decision-making
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams
 
Extra Skills That Set You Apart:

- Knowledge of AI, machine learning, generative AI, intelligent automation, or robotic process automation concepts
- Exposure to automation technologies such as Microsoft Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar platforms
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, or R
 
You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

- Curious & Innovative - You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, asking thoughtful questions, and finding smarter ways to solve complex problems.
- Technology Savvy - You are comfortable learning new tools and applying technology to improve how work gets done.
- Critical Thinker - You evaluate processes and information carefully and develop practical, well-reasoned recommendations.
- Collaborative - You enjoy working with stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand challenges and develop solutions together.
- Results-Oriented - You take ownership of your work and focus on solutions that create meaningful and measurable improvements.
We value lived experience, so if you are interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if you feel your skills don't perfectly align with those listed.
 
What You’ll Earn:
This role offers a pay range of $27.85 per hour. The base pay offered may vary depending on factors such as relevant qualifications, skills, previous experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards package, employees may also be eligible for our annual incentive program, subject to program eligibility requirements.
 
Why You’ll Love Working Here:
A career at Vancity is more than just a job, you’re joining a tradition of change-makers who are creating lasting change for our communities. Beyond base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package to ensure our employees are empowered to thrive:

- Living Wage Employer: We’re the largest private-sector Living Wage Employer in Canada and consistently ranked among Canada’s Top Employers.
- Customizable Benefits: Permanent employees receive flexible benefit packages that can be tailored annually to meet evolving needs.
- Generous Vacation: New employees start with 3-4 weeks of vacation per year, with additional days earned over time.
- Extra Stat Holidays: In addition to BC’s 11 statutory holidays, we offer 2 extra days, plus care days for personal or family illness.
- Immediate Health Coverage: Health and dental benefits begin on your hire date, with three levels of coverage to choose from.
- Defined Benefit Pension: Our retirement plan provides a guaranteed income for life, recognizing that retirement looks different for everyone.
Vancity Talent Programs:
Vancity supports an inclusive hiring process for candidates who self-identify as Indigenous, Black, or Trans. With special permission from the BC Human Rights Commissioner, this initiative provides access to career development opportunities, prioritized job screening, and feedback. Any information you choose to share will be stored securely and used only for recruitment and career development connected to this initiative, in line with the BC Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA). For details, please see our dedicated Talent Programs job posting.
At Vancity we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace to help our people and communities thrive and prosper. Diversity in our workforce is integral so that we can truly represent, understand and respond to our community needs and deliver on our member experience.
We are also committed to an inclusive, barrier-free and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require any accommodations or support at any stage of the recruitment process (including the application stage), we encourage you to let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@vancity.com. We’re here to work with you to ensure your needs are met promptly and effectively. All requests will be handled with the utmost respect and confidentiality, so you can participate fully in the process.

Le stage au sein de l’équipe de validation de produits contribue au développement d’outils d’analyse de données utilisés pour la conception et la validation de composants photoniques à haute vitesse.

- Formation : Être activement inscrit(e) à un programme menant à un diplôme en génie ou dans un domaine connexe (électrique, physique, informatique),
- Compétences en statistiques.
- Aisance à apprendre de nouvelles technologies logicielles.
- Connaissance d’un ou de plusieurs des langages suivants : Python, SQL, C#.

Atouts



- Expérience avec des outils de « big data ».
- Capacité à travailler et à communiquer en français.

Échelle Salariale

Les renseignements sur l’échelle salariale ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste.

The Opportunity: Work term of 4 months starting in January 2027. (Possible extension until August 2027)

This internship on the product validation team contributes to the development of data analysis tools used in the design and validation of high-speed photonic components.

How You Will Make An Impact



- Develop software for data analysis.
- Develop pipelines for data transformation and presentation.
- Collaborate closely with validation engineers to understand needs and define optimum solutions.

The Must Haves



- Education: Actively enrolled in a degree program in engineering or similar (electrical, physic, computer),
- Skills in statistics.
- Comfort learning new software technologies.
- Knowledge of one or many of the following languages: Python, SQL, C#.

Nice To Haves



- Experience with big data tools.
- Ability to work and communicate in French.

Pay Range

The hourly pay range for this position is $25.50 to $35.00

Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

MPI develops next-generation visual technologies for smartphone cameras and other mobile devices, collaborating with teams around the world to bring new visual experiences to Samsung’s mobile products. 

 Position Summary: 

 We are looking for a summer intern to conduct advanced research in generative AI for smartphone camera and visual technologies. You will develop and evaluate algorithms that create new visual experiences and improve existing ones, including generative approaches to low-light enhancement, super-resolution, and fast-motion capture. You will work alongside industry experts, learn how flagship camera systems operate, and help explore emerging camera technologies. • Build demos that show the feasibility and usability of new technologies.

 Note: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship . 

 Introduction:  

 We are looking for a motivated, self-driven intern who is excited to build real software with the help of AI to join our engineering team supporting major retail customers.

 Our team is helping these customers move from legacy store systems to a modern technology platform across several projects. The work includes upgrading the back-office web applications store teams use to run day-to-day operations, building new web interfaces for store services, and developing new in-store and mobile applications, from associate-facing tools to customer-facing experiences. AI will be at the center of this role, both in the features you build and in how you build them.

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student who likes to take ownership, figure things out independently, and see their work used at scale in the real world.

 What You’ll Work On: 

• Contribute to one of our new Spring 2027 retail projects, such as a new in-store application for store associates or a customer-facing mobile experience. 

• Develop and prototype AI-powered features for new and existing retail applications, such as natural-language search, smart form validation, intelligent data entry, and automated data extraction. 

• Use AI coding assistants such as Claude or Codex as a core part of your daily workflow to write, refactor, debug, and document code, and to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases and technologies. 

• Help build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines, and find ways to bring AI into the build, test, and review process. 

• Help modernize back-office web applications used to manage store data and day-to-day operations, using AI to understand and update existing code. 

• Assist with building and enhancing user interfaces using Vue, and developing and updating the Java back-end services that power them. 

• Support mobile and in-store device application development as new store technology moves from early development toward rollout. 

• Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements, ask the right questions, and work independently to find solutions. 
 
 Required Qualifications: 

• Must be able to work on-site at our Frisco, TX location at least one day per week; two days in-person preferred. 

• Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

• Understanding of AI coding tools such as Claude, Co-Pilot, or OpenAI 

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs), including how they work, prompt engineering, and their strengths and limitations when building AI-powered applications. 

• Programming knowledge in Java and/or JavaScript. 

• Solid understanding of Vue.js or a similar front-end framework (React, Angular) 

• Understanding of web application fundamentals (front end, back end, and how they connect through APIs). 

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and figure things out with minimal direction. 

• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and communication skills. 

• Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies quickly through hands-on work. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications:    

• Experience building Java back-end services or REST APIs. 

• Familiarity with agentic AI, including AI agents that plan and carry out multi-step tasks. 

• Understanding of Git, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows. 

• Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile practices. 

• Experience writing unit, integration, or automated tests. 

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and build or deployment tools. 

• Interest in retail technology and point-of-sale systems.
